handoff: Layout guard meets D4/D5 and B17–B21; AC1–AC6 tested at S1, AC7 checked by hand; typecheck and targeted tests green. Two minor findings (doctor skips machine group on old layout; status --segment blank on old layout).

findings.title: Plain `norn doctor` on an old/mixed layout skips the machine group too
findings.detail:
D7: 'Plain doctor runs the machine and repo groups and fails on either'. On old/both layout doctor returns only `{ok:false, repo:{layout}}`, so the machine checks (agents, runner, skills links) are not reported. AC4 itself (repo group fails naming migrate, non-zero, moves nothing) is met; the handoff states the skip is deliberate since the machine group needs the config's agents.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Acceptable as is; optionally run the machine group against DEFAULT_CONFIG or say in the output that machine checks were skipped (it currently says 'other checks skipped').

findings.title: `status --segment` on an old layout shows an empty tab-bar segment
findings.detail:
segment() catches every locate() error as 'not in a repository', so the new old_layout/both_layouts refusal thrown by locate() yields `{segment: "", repo: null}`: the Herdr tab bar goes blank instead of saying the checkout needs `norn migrate`.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Distinguish the layout refusal (code old_layout/both_layouts) and render it like the projectView error path (`norn ! …`).
